description_en: Queries the configurations of the auto scaling feature for an instance
description_zh: 调用DescribeAutoScalingConfig接口，查询实例弹性伸缩功能配置信息
name: DescribeAutoScalingConfig

Data.description_en: The configurations of the auto scaling feature for instances
Data.description_zh: 实例弹性伸缩功能配置信息

Bandwidth.description_en: The configurations of the automatic bandwidth adjustment feature
Bandwidth.description_zh: 实例带宽弹性伸缩功能配置信息

BandwidthUsageLowerThreshold.description_en: The average bandwidth usage threshold that triggers automatic bandwidth downgrade. Unit: %
BandwidthUsageLowerThreshold.description_zh: 触发带宽自动回缩的带宽平均使用率阈值，单位为%

BandwidthUsageUpperThreshold.description_en: The average bandwidth usage threshold that triggers automatic bandwidth adjustment. Unit: %
BandwidthUsageUpperThreshold.description_zh: 触发带宽自动扩展的带宽平均使用率阈值，单位为%

Downgrade.description_en:
Indicates whether the automatic bandwidth downgrade feature is enabled. Valid values:

true

false
Downgrade.description_zh:
带宽自动回缩是否开启：

true：是。
false：否

ObservationWindowSize.description_en:
The observation window of the automatic bandwidth adjustment feature. The return value consists of a numeric value and a time unit suffix. Valid values of the time unit suffix:

s: seconds.

m: minutes.

h: hours.

d: days.

A value of 5m indicates 5 minutes
ObservationWindowSize.description_zh:
带宽自动扩展的观测窗口。返回值由数值和时间单位后缀组成，其中时间单位后缀含义如下：

s：表示秒。
m：表示分钟。
h：表示小时。
d：表示天。 

例如，返回5m表示5分钟

Upgrade.description_en:
Indicates whether the automatic bandwidth adjustment feature is enabled. Valid values:

true

false
Upgrade.description_zh:
带宽自动扩展是否开启：
true：是。
false：否

MaxSpec.description_en:
The maximum specifications to which the cluster can be scaled up. For more information about the specifications of each type of supported database instances, see the following topics:

PolarDB for MySQL Cluster Edition instances: [Compute node specifications of PolarDB for MySQL Enterprise Edition]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/102542.html）

ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL High-availability Edition instances that use standard SSDs or ESSDs: [Specifications]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/276974.html）
MaxSpec.description_zh:
